title: Forecast revenue trends
text: Forecast next quarter’s revenue based on the past 6 quarters of data. Use the trends from our [insert dataset or industry] to explain your reasoning. Present the forecast in a table and write a short executive summary.

output: Jadual berstruktur; ketepatan angka dan sumber mesti diperiksa.
